## Infrastructure and deploy work: survey first, verified commands, `--check` before every real run

During an adopting app's first production deploy onto an existing shared server, agents wrote a host inventory before
looking at the server, gave the owner commands that do not exist as written, skipped `--check`, ignored how the apps
already on the server were set up, put the post-deploy verify behind a login, forgot public paths in the Access bypass
list, and sent the owner's steps one correction at a time. The tool-side gaps are tracked in SOFTURE/AI; this release
adds the agent rules, which apply whatever the tools do (#77).

- **WORKFLOW §14 "Infrastructure and deploy work"**, binding in both modes, seven rules: survey the server read-only
  before writing an inventory, a deploy config or a server step (`softure-host survey`, or a fixed list of read-only
  commands until it exists) and record it in `research.md`; a server that runs other apps is shared
  (`edge.manage: false`, no `softure-host server`, a deploy user without sudo, no change to sshd, Traefik or the
  firewall beyond a documented drop-in); only commands copied from the pinned package README, in the scoped
  `npx --yes --package @softure-ai/<pkg>@<version> <bin>` form outside an app; `--check` before every real run;
  verify on public paths only, every public path in the Access bypass list; one complete list of owner steps, a
  correction replaces it; a failed infrastructure step stops the chain and is reported first.
- **Managed rules block:** one paragraph in the shared part (shipped in both modes) points to §14.
- **`softure-research`:** the infrastructure survey is a required input when a change touches deploy config, an
  inventory, an edge or Access setting, or server steps; new step 7 and an `## Infrastructure survey` section in
  `research.md` (servers, commands and output, shared or not, names read from the output, public paths with their
  bypass and verify status). A missing survey is escalated, never guessed.
- **`softure-plan-review`:** new **Infrastructure and deploy** lens for §14 rules 3 to 5. A public route added without
  both the bypass entry and the verify update is CRITICAL; a plan without a survey goes back to research.
- **Release gate (`npm run validate`):** fails when WORKFLOW.md has no section 14 or the shared part of the rules block
  does not point to it.

Adopting apps: nothing to change in code. After the bump, the managed block in `AGENTS.md` gains the §14 paragraph;
changes that touch deploy config now need the survey in their research before planning.

| Change touching deploy config or a server | 0.31.0 | 0.32.0 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| research without a server survey | accepted | unfinished, survey escalated to the owner |
| plan adds a public route, no Access bypass entry | not checked | plan-review CRITICAL |
| command for the owner outside an app | any form | scoped, pinned `npx --package`, from the README, run with `--check` |
| owner steps | one message per fix | one complete list; a correction replaces it |
